mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.course_code as courseCode, c.cover_image as coverImage, c.description, c.college_id as collegeId, c.category, c.creator_id as creatorId, c.status, c.created_at as createdAt, c.updated_at as updatedAt, u.real_name as teacherName FROM student_courses sc INNER JOIN courses c ON sc.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN course_classes cc ON sc.course_class_id = cc.id INNER JOIN teachers t ON cc.teacher_id = t.id INNER JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.status = 'studying' AND c.status = 'published' ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC

SELECT id, name, course_code as courseCode, cover_image as coverImage, description, college_id as collegeId, category, creator_id as creatorId, status, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM courses WHERE course_code = #{courseCode} AND status = 'published'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_courses ( student_id, course_id, course_class_id, status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{studentId}, #{courseId}, cc.id, 'studying', NOW(), NOW() FROM course_classes cc WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM students s INNER JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.username = #{username}
